title: The Azure Twin-Edge Canon
summary: Teaches both edges of the jian as a pair and ends in the school's stroke that reaches a target from two sides.

title: Dual-Track Mastery of the Slender Blade
summary: Brings the body track and qi track of the jian student into one edge in the school's signature stroke.

title: River and Hawk Sword Course
summary: Joins the reading of a river's current with the dive of a hawk in a full course of the jian.

title: Basin Court Treatise on the Long Reach
summary: Teaches a swordsman to hold the boundaries of a fight at long reach and close them with one verdict stroke.

title: Scroll of the Soaring Azure Edge
summary: An adept's scroll of rising forms and high descents ending in the school's falling stroke under open sky.

title: River of Azure Edge Complete Treatise
summary: A treatise for a formed Core that carries the full course of a river into the jian and ends where the river meets the sky.

title: Canon of the Sworn Wind and Slender Blade
summary: Binds the jian student to the wind by oath and ends in the school's oath stroke.

title: Plateau Bearing Drill-Book
summary: Drills the taking and holding of a bearing across open plateau and ends in the school's bearing stroke.

title: Gale Without Walls: The Complete Jian Course
summary: Gives a full course of the jian that guards by motion and never by walls and ends in the school's signature stroke.

title: Oath and Edge: Sworn Forms
summary: Sets out forms in which each cut of the jian is a spoken oath and ends in the school's oath stroke.

title: Scroll of the Far Plateau Wind
summary: An adept's scroll of long-range forms that read the plateau wind and end in the school's far stroke.

title: The Unbroken Bearing Treatise
summary: A treatise for a formed Core that holds one bearing past every wind and ends in the school's last stroke.
